name: Patatas Bravas

name: Spanish Tortilla
description: A traditional Spanish omelette made with potatoes and eggs. Simple, delicious and perfect to share.

description: Golden and crispy on the outside, creamy on the inside, filled with delicious Spanish ham.

description: Juicy shrimp cooked with garlic, olive oil and a touch of chilli. A classic Spanish favourite.

name: Pan con Tomate
description: Toasted bread rubbed with fresh tomato, olive oil and salt. A Mediterranean classic.
